tagline: Act it, impersonate it, hum it

activities.name: Cameo
activities.howto: Charades. Act it out silently — no talking, no sound effects, no pointing at objects in the room.

cards.clue: A first day at a new job
Winding a cassette with a pencil

activities.name: Copycat
activities.howto: Impersonate it out loud. Talk and act like them — but never say their name or the words on the card.

cards.clue: A weather reporter in a storm
A parent using a new phone
A soccer player faking an injury
A gate agent announcing a delay
A voice actor playing a villain
A radio caller winning a prize

activities.name: Humdinger
activities.howto: Hum the tune. No words, no lyrics, no tapping out the rhythm on the table.

cards.clue: Somebody That I Used to Know
The Game of Thrones main title
The Legend of Zelda main theme
The Pirates of the Caribbean theme
